items.name: cbirds
items.description: 在终端里看鸟群飞舞。这是一款用 C 语言编写的终端鸟群动画工具，基于 Boids 算法模拟群飞。它可以在终端中用盲文点阵画出鸟群，支持 3D 模式、老鹰捕猎、鸟群拼字显示时钟和屏保模式。
items.description_en: Watch a Flock of Birds Fly in Your Terminal.This terminal flock animation tool is written in C and simulates flocking with the Boids algorithm. It draws birds in the terminal using Braille dots and supports 3D mode, eagle hunting, birds spelling out text to show a clock, and a screensaver mode.

items.name: colibri
items.description: 无需显卡运行千亿参数模型。这是一个用纯 C 编写的混合专家模型推理引擎，零依赖、不需要 GPU。它只把模型每次都要用到的部分留在内存，其余的专家权重在需要时再从硬盘读取，最低 8GB 内存就能运行 GLM、Kimi、DeepSeek、Qwen 等开源大模型，并提供兼容 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的 API，适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 系统。
items.description_en: Run 100B+ Parameter Models Without a GPU.This is a mixture-of-experts inference engine written in pure C, with zero dependencies and no GPU required. It keeps only the parts the model needs on every run in memory, and reads the remaining expert weights from disk on demand. With as little as 8GB of RAM, it can run open-source large models such as GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, and Qwen, and provides OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. It works on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

items.name: DEsk
items.description: 把 Linux 桌面变成一张书桌。该项目是基于 Wayland 的 Linux 桌面环境，整个房间采用光线追踪渲染。桌面是一张木书桌，窗口是一页页纸，最小化时像信一样折起，关闭时揉成纸团扔掉。
items.description_en: Turning the Linux Desktop into a Desk.This project is a Wayland-based Linux desktop environment, with the entire room rendered using ray tracing. The desktop is a wooden desk, windows are sheets of paper; when minimized, they fold up like letters, and when closed, they are crumpled into paper balls and tossed away.

items.name: Filee
items.description: 拖一下就能转换格式的工具。这是一款用 C# 开发的离线文件格式转换器，支持图片、PDF、Office 文档、电子书、音视频、压缩包、CAD 等 200 多种格式。操作简单，按住 Ctrl 拖动文件，光标旁就会弹出格式圆环，放到目标格式上即可完成转换，文件全程不上传，适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 系统。
items.description_en: A Drag-and-Drop File Format Converter.This is an offline file format converter built in C#. It supports over 200 formats, including images, PDF, Office documents, ebooks, audio/video, archives, and CAD. To use it, just hold Ctrl and drag a file—a format ring appears next to the cursor; drop the file on the target format to convert. Files are never uploaded, and it works on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

items.name: EditHere
items.description: 用截图告诉 AI 界面该怎么改。这是一款面向 AI 编程的截图批注工具，可以把具体怎么改整理成 AI 能直接读取的 JSON。支持悬停识别界面元素、点和框批注、拖动组件调整布局、暂停视频按帧批注，以及 OCR 和长截图，所有处理均在本地完成。
items.description_en: Use Screenshots to Tell AI How to Modify the UI.This screenshot annotation tool for AI-assisted coding turns specific UI changes into JSON that AI can read directly. It supports hover-based element detection, point and box annotations, dragging components to adjust layouts, pausing videos for frame-by-frame annotation, plus OCR and long screenshots—all processed locally.

items.name: gocryptfs
items.description: 用 Go 写的加密文件系统。该项目是基于 Go 和 FUSE 的文件加密工具，可将密文目录挂载为可读写的明文目录，文件内容和名称分别加密。生成的密文目录既能放入 Dropbox 等云盘，也可通过 rsync 增量同步。
items.description_en: An Encrypted File System Written in Go.This project is a file encryption tool built on Go and FUSE. It mounts an encrypted directory as a readable and writable plaintext directory, encrypting file contents and file names separately. The resulting encrypted directory can be stored in cloud drives like Dropbox or incrementally synced via rsync.

items.name: magpie
items.description: 一键切换 AI 编程助手的模型。这是一款用 Go 开发的 AI 编程助手模型管理工具，让 Claude Code 用上 Kimi、Codex 用上 DeepSeek。它通过本地网关转换 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Gemini 的接口格式，支持多种编程助手和模型服务商，还能把订阅共享给其他助手使用，额度用完后自动切换账号。
items.description_en: One-Click Model Switching for AI Coding Assistants.This is a Go-based model management tool for AI coding assistants that lets Claude Code use Kimi and Codex use DeepSeek. It uses a local gateway to convert between OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini API formats, supports multiple coding assistants and model providers, and can share subscriptions with other assistants, automatically switching accounts when quotas run out.

items.name: matcha
items.description: 在终端里收发邮件的客户端。这是一款用 Go 和 Bubble Tea 开发的终端邮件客户端，通过命令就能收发邮件，支持多账户、Markdown 写邮件和插件市场等功能。
items.description_en: A Terminal Email Client for Sending and Receiving Emails.A terminal email client built with Go and Bubble Tea that lets you send and receive emails via commands, with support for multiple accounts, Markdown email composition, and a plugin marketplace.

items.name: pocket-id
items.description: 无需密码的自托管身份认证服务。该项目是用 Go 开发的 OIDC 和 OAuth 2.0 身份认证服务，支持用 Passkey 替代密码。用户不用记密码，插上 YubiKey 等硬件密钥就能登录。
items.description_en: Self-Hosted Passwordless Identity Authentication Service.This project is an OIDC and OAuth 2.0 identity authentication service built in Go, with support for Passkeys instead of passwords. Users do not need to remember passwords—they can simply plug in a hardware key such as a YubiKey to log in.

items.name: GeoLibre
items.description: 在浏览器里就能用的开源 GIS 平台。该项目是用 TypeScript 开发的地理信息系统，可用于可视化、浏览和分析地理空间数据，数据保留在本地。它内置 1000 多个通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行的分析工具，涵盖地形、水文、激光雷达和遥感分析，可以运行在浏览器、桌面、手机和 Jupyter Notebook 中，还提供月球、火星等行星底图。
items.description_en: An Open-Source GIS Platform That Runs in the Browser.This project is a geographic information system built with TypeScript for visualizing, browsing, and analyzing geospatial data while keeping data local. It includes over 1,000 analysis tools that run in the browser via WebAssembly, covering terrain, hydrology, LiDAR, and remote sensing analysis. It can run in the browser, on desktop, mobile, and in Jupyter Notebook, and also provides planetary basemaps such as the Moon and Mars.

items.name: omni-tools
items.description: 可自托管的全能在线工具箱。这是一款基于 React 开发的在线工具集合，提供图片、音视频、PDF、文本、日期时间、数学计算和数据处理等日常工具，所有文件都在本地浏览器中处理。它提供图片缩放与格式转换、视频裁剪、PDF 拆分与合并、时区转换、JSON 处理等功能。
items.description_en: Self-Hosted All-in-One Online Toolbox.A React-based collection of online tools for everyday tasks such as images, audio/video, PDF, text, date/time, math, and data processing, with all files processed locally in the browser. It offers image resizing and format conversion, video trimming, PDF splitting and merging, time zone conversion, JSON manipulation, and more.

items.name: openGym
items.description: 数据由自己掌控的健身记录应用。这是一款可自托管的健身和体重记录应用，没有订阅、广告和遥测，用 Docker 一行命令即可部署。它内置 5000 多个带动画演示的动作，支持按星期安排训练计划、引导式训练、组间休息计时、自动识别个人最佳成绩，并能通过肌肉热力图查看各部位训练情况，还可以从 Strong、Hevy 等应用导入数据，提供 iPhone、Apple Watch 和 Android 版本。
items.description_en: Fitness Tracking App Where You Own Your Data.A self-hostable fitness and weight tracking app with no subscriptions, ads, or telemetry, deployable with a single Docker command. It includes over 5,000 exercises with animated demonstrations, supports weekly workout scheduling, guided workouts, rest timers between sets, automatic personal best detection, and muscle heatmaps to see training volume by body part. You can also import data from apps like Strong and Hevy, and it offers iPhone, Apple Watch, and Android versions.

items.name: puter
items.description: 运行在浏览器里的云电脑。这是一个运行在浏览器里的桌面操作系统，把文件、应用和游戏集中在一处，随时随地访问。它内置记事本、录音机、电子表格、相机等应用，还为开发者提供 AI、云存储、键值数据库和 Serverless Workers 等能力，开发的 Web 应用和游戏可以发布到它的应用商店。
items.description_en: A Cloud Computer That Runs in the Browser.This is a desktop operating system that runs in the browser, bringing files, apps, and games together in one place for access anytime, anywhere. It includes built-in apps such as Notepad, Voice Recorder, Spreadsheet, and Camera, and offers developers capabilities including AI, cloud storage, a key-value database, and Serverless Workers. Web apps and games you build can be published to its app store.

items.name: word-atlas
items.description: 一词一画的雅思背单词工具。这是一款免费开源的雅思背单词网页应用，打开浏览器就能用，无需注册。它收录 7000 多个雅思核心词，每个词都配有一幅原创插画、两条原创例句和英美发音，基于 FSRS 算法安排复习，学会的单词会在 3D 词汇星图上点亮一颗星。
items.description_en: One Word, One Picture: An IELTS Vocabulary Learning Tool.This is a free, open-source web app for IELTS vocabulary learning. It runs right in your browser and requires no sign-up. It includes over 7,000 core IELTS words, each with an original illustration, two original example sentences, and both British and American pronunciations. Reviews are scheduled using the FSRS algorithm, and every word you master lights up a star on a 3D vocabulary star map.

items.name: aerial-tv
items.description: 给电视换上 Apple TV 风格的桌面。这是一款参照 tvOS 设计的开源 Android TV 桌面，没有广告和推荐流，开机自动进入，适用于小米、TCL、创维等国产电视，以及盒子和投影仪。它支持整理应用、建文件夹、隐藏系统 App 和扫码用手机排序，安装无需 root，随时可以还原。
items.description_en: Give Your TV an Apple TV-Style Home Screen.This open-source Android TV launcher is inspired by tvOS. It has no ads or recommendation feeds and launches automatically on startup. It works on Chinese TV brands such as Xiaomi, TCL, and Skyworth, as well as TV boxes and projectors. It supports organizing apps, creating folders, hiding system apps, and sorting apps via your phone by scanning a QR code. No root required, and you can restore your original launcher anytime.

items.name: DiPlay
items.description: 在安卓设备上用 CarPlay。这是一款运行在安卓车机上的 CarPlay 应用，装在车机上即可使用有线或无线 CarPlay。它支持 Wi-Fi 直连和车载热点，可以把导航转向箭头、距离和路名投到抬显上，还能调整图标大小、分辨率和帧率，支持安卓 7.0 及以上系统和简体中文界面。
items.description_en: Using CarPlay on Android Devices.This is a CarPlay app that runs on Android head units. Once installed on the head unit, it enables wired or wireless CarPlay. It supports Wi-Fi Direct and in-car hotspots, can project navigation turn arrows, distances, and street names onto the HUD, and lets you adjust icon size, resolution, and frame rate. It supports Android 7.0 and above and a Simplified Chinese interface.

items.name: DroidDeck
items.description: 在安卓手机上玩 Steam 游戏。这是一款将 SteamOS 带到 Android 的应用，可在搭载 Adreno GPU 的安卓设备上运行 Steam 客户端，支持运行 Windows 游戏、安装 Linux 应用、登录 GOG、Epic 和 Amazon 游戏商店。
items.description_en: Play Steam Games on Android Phones.This app brings SteamOS to Android, letting you run the Steam client on Android devices with Adreno GPUs. It supports running Windows games, installing Linux apps, and signing in to GOG, Epic, and Amazon game stores.

items.name: genanki
items.description: 用 Python 生成 Anki 卡组。这是一个用于生成 Anki 记忆卡组的 Python 库，支持自定义笔记字段、卡片模板和 CSS 样式，还可添加图片和音频。修改内容并重新生成卡组后，再次导入即可覆盖已有的同名卡片，适合从单词表、题库等数据批量制作卡片。
items.description_en: Generating Anki Decks with Python.This Python library generates Anki decks and supports custom note fields, card templates, and CSS styles, along with images and audio. After you modify the content and regenerate the deck, re-importing it will overwrite existing cards with the same names—ideal for batch-creating cards from word lists, question banks, and other data sources.

items.name: kcc
items.description: 让漫画适配电子墨水屏。这是一款面向 Kindle、Kobo 等墨水屏阅读器优化漫画显示的转换工具，可将图片、CBZ、PDF 等文件转换为电子书，并按设备分辨率缩放和裁切页边。
items.description_en: Making Comics Fit E-Ink Screens.A conversion tool that optimizes comic display for e-ink readers like Kindle and Kobo. It converts images, CBZ, PDF, and other files into e-books, scaling and cropping page margins according to device resolution.

items.name: manimgx
items.description: 更快的数学动画引擎。该项目是兼容 Manim 社区版 API 的 3D 数学动画引擎，采用 GPU 渲染，速度比社区版快 90 倍。它支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程助手直接编写动画，可通过 WebGPU 在浏览器中运行或导出 MP4 视频。
items.description_en: A Faster Math Animation Engine.This project is a 3D math animation engine compatible with the Manim Community API. It uses GPU rendering and is 90x faster than the community edition. It supports AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex in writing animations directly, and can run in the browser via WebGPU or export MP4 videos.

items.name: pywinauto
items.description: 用 Python 自动操作 Windows 桌面应用。这是一个 Windows 图形界面自动化 Python 库，能够模拟鼠标和键盘操作窗口、对话框和控件，还可以读取界面上的文本数据。它支持 Win32 API 和 MS UI Automation 两种后端，可以通过窗口标题、控件名称等文本属性定位元素，几行代码就能完成打开菜单、点击按钮、输入文字等操作，适用于桌面软件的自动化测试和重复操作。
items.description_en: Automating Windows Desktop Apps with Python.This is a Python library for Windows GUI automation that can simulate mouse and keyboard actions on windows, dialogs, and controls, and read text data from the UI. It supports two backends: Win32 API and MS UI Automation. It can locate elements by text attributes such as window titles and control names. With just a few lines of code, you can open menus, click buttons, type text, and more. It is suitable for automated testing and repetitive tasks in desktop software.

items.name: tilelang
items.description: 用 Python 写高性能 GPU 算子。这是一个专为编写高性能 GPU/CPU/NPU 算子设计的领域专用语言，底层基于 TVM 编译器构建，让开发者不必手写底层代码也能实现 GEMM、FlashAttention 等算子的极致优化。它支持 NVIDIA CUDA、AMD ROCm、Apple Metal 和华为昇腾等多种硬件，内置自动调优和调试可视化工具，并提供 DeepSeek MLA 等大模型算子示例。
items.description_en: Writing High-Performance GPU Operators in Python.This is a domain-specific language designed for writing high-performance GPU/CPU/NPU operators. Built on top of the TVM compiler, it lets developers achieve highly optimized implementations of operators such as GEMM and FlashAttention without hand-writing low-level code. It supports multiple hardware backends, including NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, and Huawei Ascend, and comes with built-in auto-tuning and debugging visualization tools, plus example operators for large models such as DeepSeek MLA.

items.name: esp32sim
items.description: 开源的 ESP32 模拟器。这是一款用 Rust 编写的 ESP32 模拟器，无需开发板即可在电脑或浏览器中运行未经修改的真实固件。它完整模拟引导程序到 FreeRTOS 的启动流程，还能模拟屏幕、触摸、LED、音频、摄像头和 WiFi 等外设，支持 ESP32-S3、C3、C6、P4 等芯片。
items.description_en: Open-Source ESP32 Emulator.This is an ESP32 emulator written in Rust that lets you run unmodified real firmware on your computer or in a browser without a development board. It fully emulates the boot process from the bootloader to FreeRTOS, and can also emulate peripherals such as display, touch, LED, audio, camera, and WiFi, with support for chips including ESP32-S3, C3, C6, and P4.

items.name: miniserve
items.description: 极简的共享文件 HTTP 服务器。这是一款用 Rust 编写的命令行工具，只需一个文件就能通过 HTTP 共享文件和目录。它支持用户名密码认证、文件上传、文件夹打包下载、按名称搜索、扫码访问、TLS 和 WebDAV，还能像 GitHub 一样渲染 README.md 文件，并提供浅色和深色主题，适用于临时分享文件等场景。
items.description_en: Minimalist HTTP File-Sharing Server.A command-line tool written in Rust that shares files and directories over HTTP with just a single binary. It supports username/password authentication, file uploads, folder downloads as archives, search by name, QR code access, TLS, and WebDAV. It can also render README.md files like GitHub, offers light and dark themes, and is ideal for scenarios such as temporary file sharing.

items.name: OpenShell
items.description: 英伟达开源的 AI 智能体安全沙箱。这是一个专为自主 AI 智能体设计的安全运行时，让智能体可以读写文件、安装软件包和调用 API，又不会随意接触你的数据、密钥和网络。每个智能体都运行在隔离的沙箱中，在内核层面按策略管控文件访问、系统调用和网络连接，真实凭据只会在请求发往已批准的地址时才被注入。
items.description_en: NVIDIA's Open-Source Security Sandbox for AI Agents.A secure runtime purpose-built for autonomous AI agents, letting them read and write files, install packages, and call APIs without free rein over your data, keys, or network. Each agent runs in an isolated sandbox, with kernel-level, policy-driven controls over file access, system calls, and network connections. Real credentials are injected only when a request goes to an approved address.

items.name: anatomy
items.description: 把技术概念画成会动的机械图。这是一个为 AI 编程助手打造的插画技能，能把抽象的技术概念转化为真实可动的机械装置，绘制成精致的等距视角交互插图，比如把缓存命中画成只有每根锁销都对齐才能转动的锁芯。它支持 SVG、SVG+WebGL 着色器和 3D 三种形式，可导出为 HTML 页面、SVG 文件或 React 组件。
items.description_en: Drawing Technical Concepts as Animated Mechanical Diagrams.An illustration skill for AI coding assistants that turns abstract technical concepts into realistic, movable mechanical devices, rendered as polished isometric interactive illustrations—for example, depicting a cache hit as a lock cylinder that only turns when every pin is aligned. It supports SVG, SVG + WebGL shaders, and 3D, and can export to HTML pages, SVG files, or React components.

items.name: asd-ste100-skill
items.description: 用简化英语改写 AI 指令。该项目是基于航空航天业的简化技术英语规范，能把含糊、冗长的英文改写成不会被误读的句子，然后输入给 AI 智能体。它会逐句检查被动语态、复杂时态、一句多指令、长句和营销形容词等问题，改写时不丢失原文的任何事实和条件。
items.description_en: Rewrite AI Instructions in Simplified English.This project is based on the Simplified Technical English standard from the aerospace industry. It rewrites ambiguous, verbose English into sentences that won't be misread, then feeds them to AI agents. It checks each sentence for passive voice, complex tenses, multiple instructions in one sentence, long sentences, and marketing adjectives, without losing any facts or conditions from the original.

items.name: diagram-design
items.description: 让 AI 画出有设计感的图。这是一个为 AI 编程助手打造的图表设计技能，能生成可直接在浏览器中打开的 HTML+SVG 文件。它支持架构图、流程图、时序图、甘特图、桑基图等 45 种图表类型，能从网站自动提取品牌配色和字体，还能将 Mermaid、draw.io 和 Excalidraw 中已有的图表按统一风格重绘，并导出为 PNG 或 SVG。
items.description_en: Let AI Create Design-Forward Diagrams.This is a diagram design skill built for AI coding assistants that generates HTML+SVG files you can open directly in the browser. It supports 45 diagram types, including architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, and Sankey diagrams. It can automatically extract brand colors and fonts from websites, redraw existing diagrams from Mermaid, draw.io, and Excalidraw in a consistent style, and export them as PNG or SVG.

items.name: impeccable
items.description: 让 AI 设计的界面更有品味。这是一个为 AI 编程助手打造的前端设计技能，在 Anthropic 官方 frontend-design 的基础上扩展而来，用来避免 AI 生成千篇一律的界面，比如处处用 Inter 字体、紫蓝渐变、卡片里套卡片。它提供 polish、audit、critique 等 24 个设计命令和 62 条确定性检测规则，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 等工具。
items.description_en: Make AI-Designed Interfaces More Tasteful.A front-end design skill for AI coding assistants, extended from Anthropic's official frontend-design skill to help AI avoid cookie-cutter interfaces—such as using Inter everywhere, purple-to-blue gradients, and cards nested inside cards. It provides 24 design commands like polish, audit, and critique, plus 62 deterministic detection rules, and supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and other tools.

items.name: tendedero
items.description: 把截图晾在屏幕顶部的 macOS 工具。这是一款有趣、小巧的 macOS 截图整理工具，它会把每张截图像晾衣服一样挂在屏幕顶部的绳上，鼠标移到菜单栏时绳子滑下，移开后自动收起，让桌面不再堆满截图文件。单击即可复制，长按进入标注，拖到应用里直接发送，拖进废纸篓即可删除，还支持录屏剪辑。
items.description_en: A macOS Tool That Hangs Screenshots at the Top of Your Screen.A compact macOS screenshot organizer that hangs each screenshot like laundry on a line at the top of your screen. Move your cursor to the menu bar and the line slides down; move away and it automatically tucks itself back, keeping your desktop free from screenshot clutter. Click to copy, press and hold to annotate, drag into an app to send directly, drag to the Trash to delete, and it even supports screen recording and trimming.

items.name: xtool
items.description: 跨平台的 Xcode 替代品。这是一款用 Swift 编写的跨平台 Xcode 替代工具，可在 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 上用 SwiftPM 构建 iOS 应用并部署到真机。支持创建项目、构建运行、签名安装应用和管理设备等功能，还可以通过命令行操作 Apple 开发者服务。
items.description_en: A Cross-Platform Xcode Alternative.A cross-platform Xcode alternative written in Swift that lets you build iOS apps with SwiftPM on Linux, Windows, and macOS and deploy them to physical devices. It supports creating projects, building and running apps, signing and installing apps, and managing devices, and it also lets you work with Apple developer services from the command line.

items.name: artemis
items.description: 谷歌开源的 AI 手机自动化工具。这是一款 AI 驱动的 Android 自动化工具，只需用自然语言描述任务，AI 就会自动操作手机或模拟器，完成跨应用的测试流程和日常任务。它内置 MCP 服务，能让 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程助手直接操控手机并收集日志和截图，支持 Gemini、Claude、GPT-4o 等多模态模型。
items.description_en: Google's Open-Source AI Phone Automation Tool.This is an AI-powered Android automation tool: just describe a task in natural language, and the AI will automatically operate a phone or emulator to complete cross-app testing workflows and everyday tasks. It includes a built-in MCP server that lets AI coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex directly control the phone and collect logs and screenshots, and it supports multimodal models including Gemini, Claude, and GPT-4o.

items.name: DeepInfer
items.description: DeepSeek 开源的大模型推理框架。该项目是 DeepSeek 线上大规模服务所用的高性能推理框架，提供离线推理和大规模部署所需的核心功能。它集成了 FlashMLA、DeepGEMM、DeepEP 等自研优化算子，支持注意力数据并行、MoE 专家并行、异步调度、确定性采样和结构化输出，可运行在英伟达和华为昇腾 NPU 上。
items.description_en: DeepSeek's Open-Source Large Model Inference Framework.This project is the high-performance inference framework used for DeepSeek's large-scale online services, providing core capabilities for offline inference and large-scale deployment. It integrates self-developed optimized operators such as FlashMLA, DeepGEMM, and DeepEP, and supports attention data parallelism, MoE expert parallelism, asynchronous scheduling, deterministic sampling, and structured output. It can run on NVIDIA and Huawei Ascend NPUs.

items.name: harness2
items.description: 谷歌开源的智能体自我进化框架。这是一个让 AI 智能体在不改动模型权重的情况下，遇到陌生任务时自我改进的框架。它会针对当前任务提出修改方案，比如调整系统提示词、记忆、技能、子智能体和插件等，然后实际试跑对比效果，最后把经验沉淀下来，供后续任务使用。
items.description_en: Google's Open-Source Self-Evolving Agent Framework.This framework enables AI agents to self-improve on unfamiliar tasks without changing model weights. It proposes task-specific modifications—such as adjusting system prompts, memory, skills, sub-agents, and plugins—then runs real trials to compare results, and finally captures the lessons learned for future tasks.

items.name: UniMate
items.description: 一句话让任意 3D 角色动起来。该项目能为不同骨骼结构的 3D 模型生成动作，输入一个带骨骼的 3D 模型和一句文字描述，它就能实时生成对应的动作，不需要针对每种骨骼重新训练，适用于人形、四足动物、鸟类、海洋生物、昆虫和机械等多种骨骼结构。
items.description_en: Animate Any 3D Character with One Sentence.This project can generate motions for 3D models with different skeletal structures. Given a rigged 3D model and a text description, it can generate the corresponding motion in real time without retraining for each skeleton. It works with a variety of skeletal structures, including humanoids, quadrupeds, birds, marine creatures, insects, and mechanical rigs.

items.name: VoiceStudio
items.description: 开源的本地 AI 语音工作室。这是一款完全本地运行的语音克隆与配音工具，可作为 ElevenLabs 的开源替代品，支持 600 多种语言。它集成了 CosyVoice、IndexTTS、GPT-SoVITS、WhisperX 等多种语音合成和识别引擎，支持音色设计、视频配音、人声分离、听写和有声书制作等功能。
items.description_en: Open-Source Local AI Voice Studio.This is a fully local voice cloning and dubbing tool that serves as an open-source alternative to ElevenLabs and supports 600+ languages. It integrates multiple speech synthesis and recognition engines such as CosyVoice, IndexTTS, GPT-SoVITS, and WhisperX, with features including voice design, video dubbing, vocal separation, transcription, and audiobook production.

items.name: everything
items.description: 从零打造商业软件的开源替代品。这是由 Puter 团队发起的开源项目，目标是从零开始重新打造商业软件的免费开源替代品。目前已有 50 多款应用，包括 Excel、PPT、PS、AutoCAD、Zoom 和 Slack 的替代品，还有国际象棋、数独等小游戏，大部分都可以直接在浏览器中使用。
items.description_en: Building Open-Source Alternatives to Commercial Software from Scratch.This is an open-source project initiated by the Puter team, aiming to rebuild free, open-source alternatives to commercial software from scratch. It currently offers over 50 apps, including alternatives to Excel, PowerPoint, Photoshop, AutoCAD, Zoom, and Slack, as well as small games like chess and Sudoku—most of which can be used directly in the browser.

items.name: Future-Style-Periodic-Table
items.description: 赛博朋克风格的元素周期表。这是一个运行在浏览器中的交互式化学元素周期表，采用深色赛博朋克风格，涵盖全部 118 种元素的原子序数、电子排布、同位素和化合价等数据。它支持按原子半径、电负性、熔点等属性切换热力图，点击元素即可拖拽旋转 3D 原子模型，查看电子层结构，并提供中英文双语界面。
items.description_en: A Cyberpunk-Style Periodic Table.An interactive periodic table of chemical elements that runs in the browser with a dark cyberpunk aesthetic. It covers atomic number, electron configuration, isotopes, and valence data for all 118 elements. You can switch heatmaps based on properties such as atomic radius, electronegativity, and melting point, click any element to drag and rotate a 3D atomic model, explore its electron shell structure, and use a bilingual Chinese/English interface.

items.name: gpu-unlock
items.description: 解锁 RTX 30 系显卡的算力。这是一个 Linux 内核模块，可以把 NVIDIA RTX 30 系消费级显卡的 FP16/BF16 指令发射速率解锁到对应专业卡的水平，让矩阵运算吞吐量大幅提升。比如 RTX 3090 Ti 的 BF16 算力能从 87.5 提升到 157.4 TFLOPS，大模型预填充速度提升 14%~36%。它在 NVIDIA 官方驱动加载前完成解锁，无需修改驱动，也不用在每次驱动更新后重新打补丁。
items.description_en: Unlocking the Compute Power of RTX 30 Series GPUs.This is a Linux kernel module that unlocks the FP16/BF16 instruction issue rate of NVIDIA RTX 30 series consumer GPUs to the level of their professional counterparts, significantly boosting matrix operation throughput. For example, the BF16 compute performance of the RTX 3090 Ti can increase from 87.5 to 157.4 TFLOPS, and large model prefill speed improves by 14%–36%. It performs the unlock before the official NVIDIA driver loads, requiring no driver modifications and no need to reapply patches after each driver update.

items.name: navigation2
items.description: 开源的移动机器人导航框架。这是一个机器人自主导航框架，提供感知、定位、路径规划、运动控制和避障等功能，通过行为树编排各个模块化服务。除了基础的导航，还支持航点巡航、目标跟随和全覆盖导航等任务。
items.description_en: Open-Source Mobile Robot Navigation Framework.This is an autonomous robot navigation framework that provides perception, localization, path planning, motion control, and obstacle avoidance, with behavior trees orchestrating modular services. Beyond basic navigation, it also supports waypoint cruising, target following, and full-coverage navigation tasks.

items.name: PicLite
items.description: 极简的本地图片压缩工具。这是一款图片与动图的本地处理工具，支持批量压缩、拖动对比画质、格式转换、缩放和添加水印，会自动比较 JPEG、WebP、PNG 等候选结果并选出体积更小的文件。它提供 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 桌面端，也可在浏览器或 Docker 中使用，图片全程在本机处理，桌面端还支持文件夹监测、剪贴板自动优化和 MCP 接入。
items.description_en: A Minimalist Local Image Compression Tool.This is a local processing tool for images and animated images. It supports batch compression, drag-to-compare quality, format conversion, resizing, and watermarking. It automatically compares candidate outputs such as JPEG, WebP, and PNG, then selects the smaller file. It offers desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux, and can also be used in the browser or via Docker. All images are processed locally on your machine. The desktop version also supports folder monitoring, automatic clipboard optimization, and MCP integration.

items.name: HowToLiveBetter
items.description: 《高性价比人生指南》。这是一本介绍用少的钱、时间和精力，换回更多寿命、金钱的生活指南，涵盖长寿防病、急救、省钱理财、法律红线、失业救助、医保社保、恋爱婚育和创业合规等内容。
items.description_en: A Cost-Effective Guide to Life.A practical guide to trading less money, time, and energy for more years of life and greater financial security. It covers longevity and disease prevention, first aid, saving and money management, legal red lines, unemployment assistance, medical and social insurance, dating, marriage, and childbearing, and compliance for entrepreneurs.
